_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "generation" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "main_region" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "species" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "generation_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES generation (id), "evolution_chain_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pokemon" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "species_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES species (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "height" INTEGER NULL, "weight" INTEGER NULL, "hp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attack" INTEGER NOT NULL, "defense" INTEGER NOT NULL, "special_attack" INTEGER NOT NULL, "special_defense" INTEGER NOT NULL, "speed" INTEGER NOT NULL, "base_stat_total" INTEGER NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((((("hp" + "attack") + "defense") + "special_attack") + "special_defense") + "speed") STORED, "sprite_url" TEXT NULL, "sprite_shiny_url" TEXT NULL, "artwork_url" TEXT NULL, "artwork_shiny_url" TEXT NULL, "artwork_local_path" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "type" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_es" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pokemon_type" ("pokemon_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pokemon (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES type (id), "slot" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pokemon_id", "slot"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pokemon_form" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pokemon_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pokemon (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "form_name" TEXT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "is_mega" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_mega" IN (0, 1)), "is_battle_only" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_battle_only" IN (0, 1)), "form_order" INTEGER NULL, "sprite_url" TEXT NULL, "sprite_shiny_url" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pokemon_form_type" ("form_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pokemon_form (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES type (id), "slot" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("form_id", "slot"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "type_efficacy" ("attacking_type_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES type (id), "defending_type_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES type (id), "damage_factor" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("attacking_type_id", "defending_type_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ability" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_es" TEXT NULL, "effect_en" TEXT NULL, "effect_es" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pokemon_ability" ("pokemon_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pokemon (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "ability_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ability (id), "slot" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_hidden" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("pokemon_id", "slot"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "version_group" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "generation_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES generation (id), "sort_order" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "move" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_es" TEXT NULL, "type_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES type (id), "power" INTEGER NULL, "accuracy" INTEGER NULL, "pp" INTEGER NULL, "damage_class" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pokemon_move" ("pokemon_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pokemon (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "version_group_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES version_group (id), "learn_method" TEXT NOT NULL, "move_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES move (id), "level_learned" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pokemon_id", "version_group_id", "learn_method", "move_id", "level_learned"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "evolution" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "from_species_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES species (id), "to_species_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES species (id), "trigger_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "min_level" INTEGER NULL, "item" TEXT NULL, "min_happiness" INTEGER NULL, "time_of_day" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "egg_group" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_es" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "species_egg_group" ("species_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES species (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "egg_group_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES egg_group (id), PRIMARY KEY ("species_id", "egg_group_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "favorite" ("pokemon_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pokemon (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("pokemon_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trivia_result" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "score" INTEGER NOT NULL, "correct_answers" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_questions" INTEGER NOT NULL, "played_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trivia_answer" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "trivia_result_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES trivia_result (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "pokemon_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "correct" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("correct" IN (0, 1)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "achievement_unlocked" ("achievement_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "unlocked_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("achievement_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_metadata" ("resource_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_success_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "next_offset" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_count" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("resource_key"));
CREATE INDEX idx_species_generation ON species (generation_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_species_chain ON species (evolution_chain_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_pokemon_name ON pokemon (name)
CREATE INDEX idx_pokemon_species ON pokemon (species_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_pokemon_bst ON pokemon (base_stat_total)
CREATE INDEX idx_pokemon_type_type ON pokemon_type (type_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_pokemon_form_pokemon ON pokemon_form (pokemon_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_pokemon_ability_ability ON pokemon_ability (ability_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_evolution_from ON evolution (from_species_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_evolution_to ON evolution (to_species_id)
